mechanism: Dexamethasone may reduce piperacillin-tazobactam efficacy through immunosuppression and altered beta-lactam pharmacokinetics, while piperacillin-tazobactam can increase corticosteroid metabolism via CYP3A4 induction.
action: Monitor clinical response to infection closely; consider alternative antibiotics or higher piperacillin-tazobactam doses if inadequate response; assess infection severity given immunosuppression from dexamethasone.
